review_candidates.description: Career Opportunity: Senior Technical Specialist Prime focus of position The Senior Technical Specialist is responsible for leading and overseeing advanced regulatory and technical projects within the electronic communications domain. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulations, shaping policy development, conducting high-level technical research, and representing the Authority at the national and international levels. The Senior Technical Specialist will act as a mentor to junior staff and provide strategic guidance on regulatory and technical challenges. Main Responsibilities Direct Accountability Lead and oversee the management of the radio spectrum in compliance with national and European law. Develop and drive consultation documents, high-level technical reports, and policy or strategy documents related to electronic communications regulation. Supervise and provide guidance on investigations and compliance monitoring of operators and service providers, ensuring adherence to obligations such as interference, electromagnetic radiation, quality of service, and security. Validate notifications related to electronic communications networks, radiocommunications equipment, and spectrum assignments. Direct and manage surveys and mapping of electronic communications infrastructure, service coverage, demand, investment, and funding opportunities. Conduct and oversee strategic research on socio-economic drivers for connectivity, leading assessments of demand, investment trends, and funding opportunities. Evaluate emerging technological advancements in the electronic communications domain and propose strategic initiatives for Malta. Represent MCA at national and international regulatory and industry forums, providing expert leadership and technical input. Advise senior executives and decision-makers within MCA on technical, regulatory, and strategic matters. Develop technical regulatory frameworks and contribute to legislative updates and amendments. Engage in high-level technical liaison with governmental and industry stakeholders. Perform other high-level duties as assigned by the Chief of Spectrum Management and Technology. Management Oversee and manage complex projects independently, ensuring alignment with regulatory objectives. Lead the business planning process by defining technical strategies and objectives. Identify, develop, and implement innovative regulatory solutions and frameworks. Ensure compliance with international best practices and regulatory requirements. Mentor and coach junior and mid-level specialists, ensuring knowledge transfer and professional development. Internal Contacts Provide technical expertise within the MCA, guiding internal teams and management. Support executive leadership by providing strategic technical insights and regulatory direction. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop integrated regulatory strategies. Recommend policy adjustments based on advanced research findings and technological developments. External Contacts Engage with high-level stakeholders, including government agencies, international regulators, and industry leaders. Represent the MCA in critical discussions at the national, EU, and international levels, including within BEREC, the RSPG, CEPT and the ITU. Provide advisory and technical expertise to external entities on regulatory compliance and emerging technologies. Lead and contribute to intergovernmental and cross-industry working groups. Advanced proficiency in regulatory analysis, risk assessment, and technical compliance. Proficiency in office automation tools, data analysis software, and technical modeling tools. Ability to work independently and lead strategic initiatives.
